one_line: Poet-chronicle writer of Kashmir who composed the Rajatarangini in the 12th century.

appearance.age_look: Mid-30s, slender scholar’s build with calm, composed posture.
appearance.face: Oval face with high cheekbones, medium wheatish Kashmiri complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed black mustache and short beard along the jawline, thoughtful wide eyes with a soft intensity, default expression mildly serious and contemplative as if weighing evidence.
appearance.hair: Straight black hair parted at the center, pulled back into a small low knot at the nape of the neck; no shaved areas; a simple off-white cloth headband tied around the forehead, barely visible under a short, soft, dark brown woolen cap fitted close to the head.
appearance.costume: A knee-length Kashmiri-style scholar’s tunic (long-sleeved, slightly loose, side slits) in soft matte saffron-orange wool, worn over an off-white fine cotton inner shirt whose collar edge just peeks at the neck; a deep forest-green woolen shawl draped over both shoulders and wrapped once around the torso with one end hanging in front, subtly patterned with narrow darker-green stripes along the border; simple loose off-white cotton trousers gathered at the ankles; brown leather ankle-high shoes with rounded toes; around his neck, a single strand of small dark wooden prayer-beads and a plain bronze pendant; no royal jewelry, just a modest bronze ring on the right hand.
appearance.signature: A rolled palm-leaf manuscript secured with a thin red cord in one hand and, tucked at his waist, a slender bronze stylus used for writing on palm leaves.

ref_desc: Kalhaṇa is a mid-30s Kashmiri poet with an oval wheatish face, low-knotted black hair under a dark brown cap, saffron tunic, forest-green shawl, off-white trousers, brown shoes, and always carries a rolled palm-leaf manuscript with a bronze stylus, in warm saffron and green tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Kalhaṇa: a dignified mid-30s Kashmiri poet-chronicle writer with an oval wheatish face, high cheekbones, thoughtful wide eyes, straight nose, and a neatly trimmed black mustache with short beard along the jawline, his expression calm and contemplative. His straight black hair is center-parted and pulled into a small low knot at the nape, with a simple off-white cloth headband and a short, fitted dark brown wool cap on top. He wears a knee-length saffron-orange wool tunic with long sleeves and side slits over an off-white cotton inner shirt visible slightly at the neck, and a deep forest-green woolen shawl draped over both shoulders, wrapped once around his torso with one end hanging in front, marked by subtle narrow darker-green border stripes. He has loose off-white cotton trousers gathered at the ankles and plain brown leather ankle-high shoes. Around his neck is a single strand of small dark wooden prayer-beads and a plain bronze pendant, plus a modest bronze ring on his right hand. In one hand he holds a rolled palm-leaf manuscript tied with a thin red cord, while at his waist a slender bronze stylus is tucked as his writing tool. Use a warm, grounded palette of saffron orange, forest green, off-white, dark brown, and bronze, and show him front view, side view, and back view to clearly present face, hair, costume details, and his manuscript with stylus.
